mapper.select: select t.id as drawTeamId, t.draw_batch_id as drawBatchId, t.division_id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, t.temporary_team_code as temporaryTeamCode, t.temporary_team_name as temporaryTeamName, t.expected_member_count as expectedMemberCount, t.actual_member_count as actualMemberCount, t.long_term_team_id as longTermTeamId, lt.team_name as longTermTeamName, t.formation_status as formationStatus, t.converted_registration_id as convertedRegistrationId, t.confirmed_time as confirmedTime, b.batch_status as batchStatus, s.roster_workflow_mode as rosterWorkflowMode from basket_personal_draw_team t join basket_personal_draw_batch b on b.id = t.draw_batch_id and b.is_delete = 0 and b.batch_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'GENERATED', 'ADJUSTING', 'LOCKED') left join basket_division_format_snapshot s on s.division_id = t.division_id and s.is_current = 1 and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = t.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team lt on lt.id = t.long_term_team_id and lt.is_delete = 0 where t.is_delete = 0 and t.captain_user_id = #{captainUserId} and t.formation_status not in ('CONVERTED', 'CANCELLED') order by t.update_time desc, t.id desc

select t.id as drawTeamId, t.draw_batch_id as drawBatchId, t.division_id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, t.temporary_team_code as temporaryTeamCode, t.temporary_team_name as temporaryTeamName, t.expected_member_count as expectedMemberCount, t.actual_member_count as actualMemberCount, t.long_term_team_id as longTermTeamId, lt.team_name as longTermTeamName, t.formation_status as formationStatus, t.converted_registration_id as convertedRegistrationId from basket_personal_draw_team t left join basket_division d on d.id = t.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team lt on lt.id = t.long_term_team_id and lt.is_delete = 0 where t.id = #{drawTeamId} and t.is_delete = 0

select a.id as assignmentId, a.player_id as playerId, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as playerName, a.assignment_role as assignmentRole, a.join_status as joinStatus, a.sort_order as sortOrder from basket_personal_draw_assignment a left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = a.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where a.draw_team_id = #{drawTeamId} and a.is_delete = 0 order by a.sort_order asc, a.id asc

select t.id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, null as logoUrl, t.team_status as teamStatus, (select count(1) from basket_team_member tm where tm.team_id = t.id and tm.is_delete = 0 and tm.is_current = 1 and tm.membership_status = 1) as currentMemberCount from basket_team t where t.is_delete = 0 and t.audit_status = 1 and t.team_status = 1 and t.captain_member_id = #{memberId} order by t.update_time desc, t.id desc
